ev.q: The Overcoming COVID-19 Network conducted a case-control study during March 9, 2022–May 31, 2023
VE of maternal vaccination during pregnancy against COVID-19–related hospitalization was 35% (95% CI = 15%–51%)
Intensive care unit admissions occurred in 23% of all case-patients
Wilcoxon rank-sum tests were used to compare length of stay.
previously healthy infants accounted for 77% of case-patients
compared with 94 (28%) born to mothers of control patients
All models controlled for infant age (in months), sex, race and ethnicity
In a secondary analysis, VE among infants aged <3 months was evaluated.
The Overcoming COVID-19 Network used a case-control design to assess VE.

methods_quotes.q: Odds ratios were calculated using multivariable logistic regression
All models controlled for infant age (in months), sex, race and ethnicity, U.S. Census Bureau region, and month and year of hospital admission.
Generalized estimating equations were used to include study site as a repeated effect.
Testing for statistical significance was conducted using the Pearson’s chi-square test and Fisher’s exact test for comparisons with fewer than five observations.
Wilcoxon rank-sum tests were used to compare continuous data.
VE was calculated as (1 – adjusted odds ratio) x 100%.
